content:
Chase recently added several new benefits to its popular Sapphire Preferred credit card, including a free one-year Apple TV subscription or a discount on Apple One. Here's the details.

Chase Sapphire Preferred now offers a free one-year Apple TV subscription, or you can choose to swap it for an Apple One credit card benefit instead.

Apple TV has always been one of the perks for Chase Sapphire Reserve cardholders. However, that card carries a hefty annual fee of US$795.

Chase has now announced that Sapphire Preferred cardholders can also enjoy Apple TV for free.

Chase Sapphire Preferred is a travel-focused credit card with an annual fee of US$95, making it far more affordable than the Reserve card.

Sapphire Preferred cardholders must activate the offer before December 31, 2026 to enjoy the free one-year Apple TV subscription.

The offer is available to both new and existing customers. You simply need to link your Apple account to Chase through the Benefits platform on the Chase app or website.

The free one-year Apple TV subscription, worth US$156 in total, adds another perk to Sapphire Preferred's already long list of benefits.

As a nice touch, existing Apple One subscribers can instead enjoy a US$7.50 monthly statement credit, making Apple's bundle an even better deal.

Just link your Apple account to Chase the same way, and the credit will be applied automatically each month for any Apple One plan you subscribe to, for up to 12 months.

So whether you're already subscribed to Apple One or looking to start a subscription, you can take advantage of Chase's new offer.

Additionally, if you hold the more expensive Chase Sapphire Reserve, since the card already includes free Apple TV and Apple Music, Apple One subscribers can now receive an extra US$15 monthly statement credit. Previously, Apple One subscribers basically had no access to this extra reward.

Apple TV's monthly fee is US$12.99, though a discount is also available through the Apple One bundle.
